mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that elevates corporate earnings expectations and risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of quarterly GDPC1 growth periods, or rank correlation between GDPC1 and returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% triggers restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS >4.0% periods, or rank correlation between FEDFUNDS (above threshold) and negative returns <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline indicate labor market strength that accelerates consumer spending and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through multiplicative interaction.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of PAYEMS↑/UNRATE↓ instances, or interaction term (PAYEMS×UNRATE) shows no significant return correlation over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO decline below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO decline events during late-cycle, or rank correlation between INDPRO decline and negative returns <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL increases signal inflationary pressure that triggers short-term rate hikes, reducing equity attractiveness and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL increase periods, or rank correlation between CPIAUCSL and returns <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1200 thousand units indicates housing market contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >60% of HOUST <1200 periods, or rank correlation between HOUST (below threshold) and negative returns <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint PAYEMS growth and INDPRO expansion indicate synchronized labor and manufacturing strength that accelerates economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through interaction.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative in >60% of PAYEMS↑/INDPRO↑ instances, or interaction term (PAYEMS×INDPRO) shows no return correlation over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS above 4.5% sustains restrictive policy that elevates discount rates and reduces equity multiples, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS >4.5% periods during tightening cycles, or rank correlation between FEDFUNDS (in cycle) and negative returns <0.03 over any 3-year window.
